note: Bill's own curated list of movies — and, since 2026-10-16, TV shows too (Bill: "allow this to have TV shows too") — to watch with his whole family, a separate category from the solo recommendation flow. Each entry's titleKey also exists in candidatePool.json (source: family-watch-list) so it gets real TMDB enrichment (poster/genre/overview) for free, and in feedbackData.json with excludeFromRecommendations so it never surfaces in the solo You'll Love panels or competes for a candidate-pool cap slot. A movie entry uses theatricalReleaseDate; a show entry (titleKey starts show:) uses premiereDate instead, since a show has no theatrical run — dashboardShared.js's renderFamilyWatchList() branches the display label (In theaters/Released vs Premieres/Premiered) on which one is present. streaming and both release-date fields are real, hand-researched fields (via WebSearch against real outside sources, never guessed) — TMDB has no reliable field for either, especially forward-looking VOD/streaming dates, so this mirrors the same discipline trakt/data/upcomingSeasons.json already established for renewal status.
